package.name: robot_realtime
package.description: Gemini Live realtime audio bridge. Replaces the STT -> Hermes -> TTS pipeline with a single WebSocket session to gemini-3.1-flash-live for <1s end-to-end conversational latency. Subscribes to the existing /audio/chunk and publishes to /audio/stream so the rest of the ROS2 graph (face hardware, voice_identifier, location memory, vision) keeps working unchanged. Function calls from the model are relayed to the existing MCP server at 127.0.0.1:8765.
